name: question
description: Ask the user exactly one question through this tool — never ask in plain reply text. The loop pauses until answered, then continues with the answer (shown inside this step). Three kinds: choices (options with up to 4 short strings, shown as lettered rows; the user may also type their own), essay (omit options for a free-typed answer), true/false (options exactly ["True", "False"]). Keep the question to one sentence (max 2000 chars); each option max 200 chars and unique. Use whenever a critical requirement is missing, options are ambiguous, or an action is destructive and irreversible (deleting files, altering databases) — never guess when you can ask.

options.description: Up to 4 unique choices (max 200 chars each), shown as lettered rows. Omit entirely for an open-ended (essay) answer; pass exactly ["True", "False"] for confirmations.
